download_file: download a file from a URL to a local path with progress reporting and rollback on failure
download_and_extract: download a compressed file from a URL and automatically extract it to a temporary directory
extract_archive: extract a compressed file (tar.gz, zip, gz, bz2) to an output directory and return extracted paths
git_clone_repo: clone a git repository to a specified output directory with optional overwrite of existing directory
replace_lrb_rrb: replace -lrb- and -rrb- placeholders with parentheses in a text file in place
